import unittest

from tests.helpers import BOOKS, d, library


class Renew(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_a_renewal_and_its_limit(self):
        lib = library()
        lib.lend(BOOKS[0].isbn, "m1", d("2026-03-01"))
        self.assertEqual(lib.renew(BOOKS[0].isbn, d("2026-03-02")).due, d("2026-04-12"))
        lib.renew(BOOKS[0].isbn, d("2026-03-03"))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            lib.renew(BOOKS[0].isbn, d("2026-03-04"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
